ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 70-75 percent high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to 25-30 percent low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes characterized by high-intensity white pigmentation with diffuse yellowish-tan biofouling patches in the medial and lower regions. Low-intensity black margins form a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and outer leading edges. Three distinct, high-contrast dark circular spots are localized in the upper-distal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; pixel angle estimated at approximately 55 degrees with a bounding-box depth of roughly 15 percent of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with prominent high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 25 pixels). Multiple secondary notches and jagged protrusions are visible across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a complex irregular concave sweep from the median notch to the tips; leading edges are predominantly linear with slight terminal convexity at the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to acorn barnacle colonization. Several isolated high-contrast white circular spots (diameter 5-10 pixels) are visible on the lower inner surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark near-vertical linear streaks (rake marks) originating from the caudal peduncle insertion area and extending upward into the white pigmentation of the central lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural irregularity at distal tips due to heavy barnacle colonization; distinct dark circular pigmentation scars/spots on the upper right lobe; multiple deep trailing edge indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'double-spot' pigmentation pattern on the right lobe resembling a pair of eyes.
